name: H3 Extend Video BF16
summary: Continues a clip from its last 39 frames of motion context, on the full-base BF16 MiniMax H3, and joins the trimmed continuation after it.

source.notes: Core-node rewrite of extend-video: the last N frames (5/22/39, the H3 17k+5 grid) are anchored at frame 0 with MiniMaxH3AddGuide plus the matching audio tail, instead of a single first frame. The decoded head is sliced off with ImageFromBatch and the audio with TrimAudioDuration before concatenation. No custom nodes.

inputs.label: Clip to extend
inputs.help: The continuation is appended after this clip. Keep it at least 2 seconds.

inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.default: The scene continues naturally: same people, place, light and camera style.
inputs.help: Describe what happens next. The model already sees the end of the clip.

inputs.label: New part (s)
inputs.help: Length of the generated clip before the motion context is trimmed; the visible addition is shorter by the context length.

inputs.label: Motion context
inputs.help: Frames carried into the new clip as a motion guide. 39 is the community standard; must stay shorter than the new part.

inputs.label: Steps
inputs.help: Fewer steps run faster and look rougher.

credits: Motion-context chaining follows the MiniMax H3 community Extender research (tritant/ComfyUI_MiniMax_H3_Extender, NikoDemon80/ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context)
notes: Uses MiniMaxH3AddGuide to anchor a multi-frame clip, which ComfyUI crops to the model's valid 17k+5 clip lengths. The exact start point of the context is the last N frames; starting a context window earlier in the source (and replacing the tail) needs the previous clip's sampled latent, so it is not part of this core-node version.

test.prompt: the cat stretches and walks out of frame
